# GCP to AWS Migration Guide

This guide covers migrating your workloads from Google Cloud Platform to Amazon Web Services.

## Setting Up AWS IAM Permissions

To configure your AWS environment, navigate to the AWS Management Console and open the IAM service.
In the left navigation panel, click on "Roles" and then click the "Create role" button.
Select "AWS service" as the trusted entity type and choose the appropriate service.
Click through the wizard to configure permissions and create the role.

## Migration Steps

1. Open the AWS Console at https://console.aws.amazon.com
2. Navigate to IAM > Roles
3. Click "Create role"
4. Follow the wizard to complete role creation
